title: Resilience & Hope
intro: Small children fall over, lose things, get left out and are told no about forty times a day. This month gives them the two sentences that will serve them for the rest of their lives: it will not always be like this, and you can try again tomorrow.

keyScriptures.text: Though the righteous fall seven times, they rise again.
His mercies are new every morning.

weeks.title: You Can Try Again
weeks.declaration: Getting it wrong is not the end. You can try again, and again, and nobody is counting.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, take the sting out of failing for our child. Let trying be safe here. Amen.

weeks.title: Sad Does Not Last Forever
weeks.declaration: Being sad is real and it does not last forever. Both of those are true.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, let our child learn that feelings pass without being told their feelings do not matter. Amen.

weeks.title: You Can Tell Us
weeks.declaration: When something is hard, you can say so. Saying it out loud makes it smaller.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, let nothing be too small or too big for our child to bring us. Amen.

weeks.title: Tomorrow Is New
weeks.declaration: Tomorrow starts again. However today went, it does not have to come with you.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, let every morning in this house be a fresh start. Amen.

days.title: Try Again
days.declaration: Getting it wrong is not the end. Have another go.

scripture.text: Though the righteous fall seven times, they rise again.

days.title: Sad Does Not Last
days.declaration: Being sad is real, and it does not last forever. Both are true.

scripture.text: Rejoicing comes in the morning.

days.title: Tell Us When It Is Hard
days.declaration: When something is hard, say so. Saying it makes it smaller.

scripture.text: Carry each other's burdens.

days.title: Tomorrow Is New
days.declaration: Tomorrow starts again. Today does not have to come with you.

scripture.text: His mercies are new every morning.

days.title: Crying Helps
days.declaration: Crying is not naughty. It is how a body lets sad out.

scripture.text: Jesus wept.

days.title: Not Being Chosen
days.declaration: Not being picked hurts. It does not mean something is wrong with you.

scripture.text: The Lord will receive me.

days.title: Losing Something
days.declaration: Losing something is sad. You are still the same person without it.

scripture.text: Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth.

days.title: Hard Things Get Easier
days.declaration: Something hard today will be easier in a while. That is how hands and legs work.

scripture.text: Those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength.

days.title: God Is Close When You Are Sad
days.declaration: When you are sad, God comes closer rather than going away.

scripture.text: The Lord is close to the broken-hearted.

days.title: Small Steps
days.declaration: On a hard day, one little step is a real step. That is plenty.

scripture.text: Do not despise these small beginnings.

days.title: Getting Told No
days.declaration: Being told no is not being told you are bad. Sometimes no keeps you safe.

scripture.text: No discipline seems pleasant at the time.

days.title: Falling Over
days.declaration: Falling over is part of learning to run. Everybody does it.

scripture.text: Though I have fallen, I will rise.

days.title: Being Poorly
days.declaration: Being poorly is horrible and it stops. We will look after you until it does.

scripture.text: The Lord sustains them on their sickbed.

days.title: Waiting Is Hard
days.declaration: Waiting is hard and you can do hard things. It gets easier with practice.

scripture.text: Wait for the Lord.

days.title: Someone Is Holding On
days.declaration: When everything feels wobbly, someone is holding on to you.

scripture.text: I take hold of your right hand.

days.title: A Bad Day Is One Day
days.declaration: A bad day is just one day. It is not what your life is like.

scripture.text: Put your hope in God.

days.title: It Was Not Your Fault
days.declaration: Some sad things are nobody's fault, and definitely not yours.

scripture.text: Neither this man nor his parents sinned.

days.title: Broken Things Get Mended
days.declaration: Lots of broken things can be mended. Some cannot, and that is allowed to be sad.

scripture.text: A time to weep and a time to laugh.

days.title: Being Brave About Feelings
days.declaration: Saying 'I am sad' is a brave thing to say. Well done for saying it.

scripture.text: Pour out your hearts to him.

days.title: Not Alone
days.declaration: Whatever it is, you are not the only one it has happened to.

scripture.text: Nothing has overtaken you except what is common to mankind.

days.title: Kind to Yourself
days.declaration: Be kind to yourself. You would be kind to a friend having this day.

scripture.text: Love your neighbour as yourself.

days.title: Rest Helps
days.declaration: When it has all gone wrong, sometimes the answer is a rest and a snack.

scripture.text: I will give you rest.

days.title: Angry Is Allowed
days.declaration: Being angry is allowed. Hurting people is not. We will help you.

scripture.text: In your anger do not sin.

days.title: Hope Means Good Is Coming
days.declaration: Hope means expecting something good, even when today was not.

scripture.text: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace.

days.title: You Got Through It
days.declaration: Look at all the hard days you have already got through. You did that.

scripture.text: Thus far the Lord has helped us.

days.title: Changing Is Allowed
days.declaration: If something is not working, you can try a different way.

scripture.text: See, I am doing a new thing!

days.title: Nothing Is Wasted
days.declaration: Even the horrible parts get used for something good later.

scripture.text: In all things God works for the good.

days.title: Good Comes Back
days.declaration: Good days come back. This is not the last one you will have.

scripture.text: You turned my wailing into dancing.

days.title: You Are Getting Stronger
days.declaration: The hard things you get through make you someone who can do more.

scripture.text: The testing of your faith produces perseverance.

days.title: Still Loved
days.declaration: On the worst day you have ever had, you are still completely loved.

scripture.text: Nothing can separate us from the love of God.

days.title: Remember It Tomorrow
days.declaration: Remember today, because you got through it. That is useful to know.

scripture.text: Perseverance produces character; and character, hope.
